# The custom-header filter test omits the expected-behavior message on its total-count assertion

The new custom-header filter test checks the total message count with a two-argument Assert.equal and therefore has no failure message. Its adjacent half-unread assertion does state the expected result. Keep that direct assertion check separate from the mock setup and the wait for any count change. Under the current user-directed assertion rule, the total-count assertion needs a nonempty expected-behavior message; this is not a claim that historical accepted code defines a preferred message exception.

Scope: Exchange custom-header test assertions.
